title: Forty Years and Three Smells
subtitle: 烹饪与菜系 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 烹饪与菜系（历史社会与文化·饮食文化）
meta: 主题语境：烹饪与菜系（历史社会与文化·饮食文化）　|　核心词汇：cuisine　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cuisine 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 my grandmother ① served a cuisine that no restaurant in the county would have matched, and she said the serving was the whole of the inheritance. The ② cuisine, meaning the cooking and not the dishes, ran forty years and stayed unwritten; cuisine, she said, is the only thing in a kitchen that is judged by how long it is left unwritten.

Every ③ cuisine in that house had the same three smells against it, and the ④ cuisine at the end, meaning the one she kept for the winter and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever asked for twice. Cuisine, my mother said, is nine parts habit and one part somebody willing to wait; my grandmother said the waiting is the part that fills forty years.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the cuisine was the whole of the region, meaning the style and not the cooking. The ⑥ cuisine, meaning the style and not any of that, is the only thing in a region that everybody names and nobody defines; cuisine, he said, is either something you serve or the only word that means both a cooking and a style. He said the style is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ cuisine had become a chapter in a book, and the book had become an argument about the three smells. The ⑧ cuisine of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in June, was one house and forty years of waiting; cuisine, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to wait. She said the waiting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ cuisine I remember is the one at the end, which was served in 1984 and is still described as the finest in the county. A ⑩ cuisine, my grandmother said in 1986, is the only thing that improves by being waited for; every cuisine, she said, is a style that has agreed to look like a cooking. She said the style was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 菜肴；饭菜（指端上桌、被人点到的那一道）
B. n. 烹饪（指烹调技艺本身，与那些菜相对）
C. 固定搭配：serve a cuisine 端出（呈现）一种菜系风味
D. n. 菜肴（指为冬天留着的那一道）
E. n. 烹饪；烹饪之道（抽象总称，指一家人的全部手艺）
F. n. 菜系（指书里写到、被记下来的那一个）
G. n. 菜系（指整个地区公认的那一个）
H. n. 烹饪风格（抽象总称，指某地区特有的做法）

items.q: served a cuisine that no restaurant in the county would have matched
The cuisine, meaning the cooking and not the dishes
the cuisine was the whole of the region
the cuisine had become a chapter in a book
The cuisine of the whole thing
A cuisine, my grandmother said in 1986

answers.why: serve a cuisine 意为“端出（呈现）一种菜系风味”，1968 年祖母端出的那一种，全县没有一家餐馆比得上。
cuisine 意为“烹饪”，指烹调技艺本身而不是那些菜，它延续了四十年而从未被写下来。
cuisine 意为“菜肴”，指那栋房子里端上桌的每一道，每一道都有同样的三种气味。
cuisine 意为“菜肴”，指为冬天留着的那一道，是唯一有人点过第二次的。
cuisine 意为“菜系”，指整个地区公认的那一个，父亲说这个菜系就是整个地区的全部。
cuisine 意为“烹饪风格”，指某地区特有的做法而不是烹调本身，是一个地区里人人都叫得出、却无人能定义的那种东西。
cuisine 意为“菜系”，指书里写到、被记下来的那一个，到 1979 年这个菜系成了书里的一章。
cuisine 意为“烹饪、烹饪之道”，祖母六月写道，整件事的烹饪之道是一栋房子和四十年的等待。
cuisine 意为“菜肴”，我记得的是末尾那一道，1984 年端上桌，至今仍被说成全县最好的一道。
cuisine 为抽象总称，祖母 1986 年说，一种烹饪之道是唯一会因为被等待而变得更好的东西。
